description: Weekly orders export from Trailhead Outfitters (fictional e-commerce vendor). Contract taken from the hand-written golden ETL of Phase 1.4.

columns.name: order_date
columns.description: Date the order was placed; null when unknown.

columns.name: email_is_valid
columns.description: Whether the buyer's email has the form name@domain.tld.

columns.name: email_sha256
columns.description: SHA-256 of the trimmed, lower-cased email (PII masked).

columns.name: phone_sha256
columns.description: SHA-256 of the phone in E.164 form (PII masked).

columns.name: unit_price
columns.description: Price per unit in the order currency.

columns.name: discount_code
columns.description: Promo code; usually empty by design.

columns.name: order_status
columns.description: Lifecycle state, one of 5 canonical values.

partition.name: order_month
partition.rule: 'YYYY-MM' from order_date, or 'unknown' when order_date is null

cleaning_rules: order_date: Python date. Parse every layout the profile shows.
order_status: lower-case, one of: delivered, shipped, pending, cancelled, returned. Map spelling variants onto these.
ship_country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, upper-case. currency: ISO 4217, upper-case.
unit_price: decimal.Decimal quantized to 0.01; strip currency symbols and thousands separators.
quantity: integer ("2.0" -> 2); a fractional quantity raises ValueError. Use pandas Int64.
customer_email: trim + lower-case. email_is_valid = matches name@domain.tld. email_sha256 = SHA-256 hex of the normalised email (null if no email).
phone: normalise to E.164 (+<calling code><digits>), using the calling code of the row's ship_country when the number has no '+'. phone_sha256 = SHA-256 hex (null if no phone).
customer_name: drop it (customer_id identifies the buyer).
discount_code: upper-case. customer_id, product_sku, notes: trimmed text.
